title: Existence And Being
definition: The philosophical exploration of what it means to exist and be.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Thinking about what things are and how they relate to each other and to existence itself.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Existence and Being involve the analysis of concepts like essence, substance, attributes, and predication.
difficulty_levels.expert: At its core, Existence and Being is a long-standing philosophical question that has been explored through various theories.
